reason: An Electron desktop shell that installs and runs the DeepSeek Harness web interface locally, with bundled Node and pnpm runtime management.

summaries.zh: 这是一个基于 Electron 的桌面应用，用于安装并在本地运行 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面。
summaries.en: An Electron desktop application for installing and running the DeepSeek Harness web interface locally.

capabilities: Installs the @deepseek-ai/dsh runtime into the user home directory
Spawns a local dsh web server on 127.0.0.1
Displays the DSH web interface in an Electron desktop window
Checks for and supports runtime updates
